$comment: Image budgets checked by `npm run assets -- check` (scripts/assets.js), in the CI (.woodpecker/checks.yml). Each image takes maxImage (bytes) and maxSide (pixels, optional) from the first rule with maxImage whose path matches, and is summed into the group of the first rule with maxTotal. A path ending in / is a directory, * stands for one segment (src/games/*/ = one group per game), '' matches everything. The painted scenes (60 kB) and the hide-and-seek props (20 kB) use the same limits as scripts/check-precache.js, which checks the built files. Raise a budget in the same commit as the asset that needs it, with the measured size in the message.
